modules.name: Core
modules.description: Mods panel, settings, module manager and launcher bridge. Always installed.

changes: Every module has a “Changelog” link in Settings, installed or not.
Turning on a module you don't have asks first: it shows the version, its latest changes and the libraries it brings, then “Install”.
Modules with several features list them under their row: click one to hide it from the panel and turn it off (e.g. Flee mode).
What's new only shows updates to install and the last update you installed; “Show full history” unfolds the rest.
Settings tell you in red when the launcher is no longer running, instead of showing stale information and settings that do nothing.
What's new highlights the changes of the last update you installed, until the module's next update.
What's new and Review updates highlight what you haven't installed yet in green.
“New” and “Update” badges are green; a module being uninstalled or no longer published is shown in red.
A module that is no longer published gets an “Uninstall” button instead of a note pointing to the launcher settings file.
Changelog lines starting with “Removed:” are shown in red.
The mod is split into modules: pick the features you want in ⚙ Settings, only their code runs and gets updated.
New modules show up in Settings with a “New” badge and are never installed automatically.
“What's new” lists the changelog of your modules; “Review updates” shows it next to the exact code diff.
Can force Gather to redraw the map, which it otherwise only does when something changes.
Box selection toggles objects, like a click.
Initial version.

modules.name: Map picking
modules.description: Shared object selection on the map (click, box, scroll to cycle).

changes: Selection outlines show up and go away immediately, even when started or stopped from the panel.
The yellow hover outline follows the object named in the tooltip, even between close objects.
Initial version.
Initial version.

modules.description: Shared journal of the objects placed with the mod.

changes: Initial version.

modules.name: Job queue
modules.description: Shared queue that runs map edits one after the other, in click order.

changes: Initial version.

modules.name: Hub API
modules.description: Shared requests to the community hub.

changes: Initial version.

modules.name: Teleport
modules.description: Teleport mode (every “Go to” and double-click teleports), TP to your desk, TP to players and saved locations.

changes: Teleport mode, TP to my desk, Players and Saved locations can each be hidden in Settings (a hidden Teleport mode is off).
Teleport mode, TP to desk, TP to players and saved locations, now in one module.

modules.name: Fun
modules.description: Gimmicks. Flee mode: keep your distance from a chosen player. Animations: make objects orbit or move back and forth, seen by everyone with this module.

changes: Flee mode and Animations can each be hidden in Settings; a hidden one is turned off (hidden animations are no longer fetched nor played).
The animation list only shows yours; the others' still play on the map.
Animations: select objects, make them orbit around a point or move back and forth in a straight line or along a wave, with a live preview, then save.
Everyone on the map who has this module sees your animations, in sync; only you can start, stop or delete yours.
Nothing is sent to Gather's server: objects only move on screen, and the map is redrawn at 30 fps at most while an animation runs.
Flee mode moves here from the player list.

modules.name: Build
modules.description: Free placement in the build tool, “Place on…” to put objects on any other object, and bulk delete (click or drag a box to select).

changes: Free placement, Place on… and Bulk delete can each be hidden in Settings (a hidden Free placement is off).
Place on… and bulk delete no longer wait for the previous one to finish: start the next one right away, it is queued.
Objects moved with Place on… are listed in Placed objects.
Dragging a box over already selected objects deselects them, like a click.
Free placement, Place on… and bulk delete, now in one module.

modules.name: Outfits
modules.description: Save and apply outfits, including “No outfit” and “Invisible”.

changes: Outfit presets as a module.

modules.name: Desks
modules.description: Save and swap your desk decoration, and pick which objects belong to your desk.

changes: Picking another desk while one is being applied stops it and applies the new one; “↩ Previous desk” still brings back the desk you had before the first one.
Objects added by a desk preset are listed in Placed objects.
Dragging a box over desk objects already picked removes them, like a click.
Desk presets as a module.

modules.name: Constructions
modules.description: Save a group of objects and place it anywhere on the map in one click.

changes: Place several constructions and click “↶ Delete last” several times without waiting: each action is queued and runs in order.
“↶ Undo” becomes “↶ Delete last”, using the shared journal of placed objects (keeps your history).
Dragging a box over already selected objects deselects them, like a click.
Constructions as a module.

modules.name: Placed objects
modules.description: Everything you placed with the mod on this map (constructions, desk presets, Place on…): delete the last one, any of them, or all.

changes: Deletions no longer wait for the previous one: click several ✕ or “↶ Delete last” in a row, they are queued and run in order.
New module: list what the mod placed on this map, hover to see it, delete the last placement, any of them, or all (everything is outlined in red before you confirm).

modules.name: Share presets
modules.description: Export and import the presets of your installed modules as JSON.

changes: Export and import only cover the preset modules you have installed.

modules.name: Community hub
modules.description: Browse, preview, add and publish presets shared by others.

changes: Hub requests go through the shared hub library, also used by animations.
Hub tabs follow your installed preset modules.
